# Spatial structure - mutualists

## Dependencies and setup

```{r}
install.packages(tidyverse)
install.packages(cowplot)
install.packages(RColorBrewer)
install.packages(khroma)
install.packages(rstatix)
install.packages(knitr)
install.packages(kableExtra)
install.packages(viridis)
install.packages(gganimate)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(khroma)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(viridis)
# library(webshot2)
library(magick)
library(gganimate)
```

```{r}
# Build relative path from R's working directory to what is actually the working
# directory for this experiment.
experiment_slug <- "2026-11-11-spatial-barbell"
working_directory <- paste(
  "experiments",
  experiment_slug,
  "analysis",
  sep = "/"
)
```

```{r}
# Use the cowplot theme as our default for ggplots
theme_set(theme_cowplot())
# Create directory to save plots
plot_dir <- paste(
  working_directory,
  "spatial-plots",
  sep = "/"
)
dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

### Load and preprocess data

```{r}
tasks <- c("NOT", "NAND", "OR_NOT", "AND", "OR", "AND_NOT", "NOR", "XOR", "EQU")
task_colors <- c(
  "NA" = "#000000",
  "NAND" = "#9259be",
  "NOT" = "#a04c78",
  "ORN" = "#4a87c3",
  "AND" = "#477bd4",
  "OR" = "#4e828d",
  "ANDN" = "#71a756",
  "NOR" = "#ecc047",
  "XOR" = "#df8e44",
  "EQU" = "#c20010"
)
```

## Load Final Update Spatial data. NEEDS TO BE CHANGED TO BETTER WORK WITH OVER TIME DATA
```{r}
spatial_data_path <- paste(
  working_directory,
  "spatial_data",
  "2500-5000-99024.csv",

  sep = "/"
)

headers <- names(read_csv(spatial_data_path, n_max = 0))
spatial_data_satic <- read_csv(spatial_data_path, skip = 10001, col_names = headers)

spatial_data_satic <- spatial_data_satic %>%
  mutate(
    update = as.factor(update),
    location_id = as.numeric(location_id),
    host_present = as.factor(host_present),
    endosymbionts_present = as.factor(endosymbionts_present),
    host_interaction_value = as.factor(host_interaction_value),
    endosym_interaction_values = as.factor(endosym_interaction_values),
    host_task_profile = as.factor(host_task_profile),
    host_parent_tasks = as.numeric(host_parent_tasks),
    endosym_task_profiles = as.factor(endosym_task_profiles),
    endosym_parent_tasks = as.factor(endosym_parent_tasks),
    host_sym_task_profile_compatibility = as.factor(host_sym_task_profile_compatibility),
    host_lineage_length = as.factor(host_lineage_length),
    endosym_lineage_length = as.factor(endosym_lineage_length)
  )
```


## GGPlot Final Task
```{r}
spatial_matrix <- spatial_data_satic %>%
  mutate(
    X = factor(location_id %/% 50),
    Y = factor(location_id %% 50)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task = case_when(
      host_parent_tasks == "000000000" ~ "NA",
      host_parent_tasks == "100000000" ~ "NAND",
      host_parent_tasks == "010000000" ~ "NOT",
      host_parent_tasks == "001000000" ~ "ORN",
      host_parent_tasks == "000100000" ~ "AND",
      host_parent_tasks == "000010000" ~ "OR",
      host_parent_tasks == "000001000" ~ "ANDN",
      host_parent_tasks == "000000100" ~ "NOR",
      host_parent_tasks == "000000010" ~ "XOR",
      host_parent_tasks == "000000001" ~ "EQU",
    ),
    task = factor(task, levels = names(task_colors))
  ) %>%
  select(X, Y, task)

graph <- ggplot(spatial_matrix, aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = task, color = task)) + 
  geom_tile(width = 1.01, height = 1.01, linewidth = 0.2) + 
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(90.5, 110.5),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = .01
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = task_colors,
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = task_colors,
    na.value = "transparent"
  )

ggsave(file = paste(plot_dir, "2500-5000-99024-heatmap.pdf", sep = "/"), plot = graph, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```

## OverTime Animation
## Loading data
```{r}
spatial_data_path <- paste(
  working_directory,
  "spatial_data",
  "2500-5000-99024.csv",

  sep = "/"
)

interval_count <- 1
total_updates <- 200000
update_diff <- total_updates/interval_count

headers <- names(read_csv(spatial_data_path, n_max = 0))
spatial_data_dynamic <- read_csv(spatial_data_path, skip = 1, col_names = headers)

spatial_data_dynamic <- spatial_data_dynamic %>%
  mutate(
    update = as.factor(update),
    location_id = as.factor(location_id),
    host_present = as.factor(host_present),
    endosymbionts_present = as.factor(endosymbionts_present),
    host_interaction_value = as.factor(host_interaction_value),
    endosym_interaction_values = as.factor(endosym_interaction_values),
    host_task_profile = as.factor(host_task_profile),
    host_parent_tasks = as.factor(host_parent_tasks),
    endosym_task_profiles = as.factor(endosym_task_profiles),
    endosym_parent_tasks = as.factor(endosym_parent_tasks),
    host_sym_task_profile_compatibility = as.factor(host_sym_task_profile_compatibility),
    host_lineage_length = as.factor(host_lineage_length),
    endosym_lineage_length = as.factor(endosym_lineage_length)
  )
```

Make Animation
```{r}
spatial_matrix <- spatial_data_dynamic %>%
  mutate(
    X = factor(((as.numeric(location_id) - 1) %/% 50) + 1),
    Y = factor(((as.numeric(location_id) - 1) %% 50) + 1),
    frame = as.numeric(update)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task = case_when(
      host_parent_tasks == "000000000" ~ "NA",
      host_parent_tasks == "100000000" ~ "NAND",
      host_parent_tasks == "010000000" ~ "NOT",
      host_parent_tasks == "001000000" ~ "ORN",
      host_parent_tasks == "000100000" ~ "AND",
      host_parent_tasks == "000010000" ~ "OR",
      host_parent_tasks == "000001000" ~ "ANDN",
      host_parent_tasks == "000000100" ~ "NOR",
      host_parent_tasks == "000000010" ~ "XOR",
      host_parent_tasks == "000000001" ~ "EQU",
    ),
    task = factor(task, levels = names(task_colors))
  ) %>%
  select(X, Y, task, frame, update)


```

WIP, Works for now
```{r}

graph <- ggplot(spatial_matrix, aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = task, color = task), ) +
  geom_tile(width = 1.01, height = 1.01, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(90.5, 110.5), color = "black", linewidth = .01) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = task_colors, na.value = "transparent") +
  transition_manual(update) +
  scale_color_manual(values = task_colors, na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = "Update: {format(as.numeric(current_frame), big.mark = ',', scientific = FALSE)}") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))

animation <- animate(graph, nframe = 4, duration = 4,  width = 854, height = 480, units = "px", res = 100)

anim_save(animation, file = paste(plot_dir, "2500-5000-99024-heatmap-dy.gif", sep = "/"))
```
